articles.headline: No. 16 Washington women beat Stanford 105-50, the Cardinal's worst loss in program history
articles.description: — Brynn McGaughy scored a career-high 21 points, Avery Howell added 20 points on 7-of-10 shooting and No. 16 Washington handed Stanford its worst loss in program history, beating the Cardinal 105-50 on Friday night.

articles.headline: JuJu Watkins takes over, scores season-high 36 to rally No. 4 USC past Baylor
articles.description: JuJu Watkins had 36 points and 11 rebounds as No. 4 USC came back from an early 15-point deficit to beat Baylor 78-69 on Friday night.

articles.headline: No. 4 USC rallies from 15 down behind JuJu Watkins to beat Baylor 78-69 at Intuit Dome
articles.description: — JuJu Watkins scored a season-high 36 points and No. 4 Southern California rallied from an early 15-point deficit to beat Baylor 78-69 on Friday night at the Hollywood Hardwood Classic in the first women's college basketball game played at Intuit Dome.

articles.headline: Quinonez, Popovic lead No. 7 UConn past Seton Hall for 59th straight Big East regular-season victory
articles.description: — Jovana Popovic had 20 points and Blanca Quinonez scored all 18 of her points in the first half as seventh-ranked UConn defeated Seton Hall 83-43 in its Big East opener on Friday night to extend its Big East regular-season winning streak to 59 games.

articles.headline: Crooks scores 20 to move up Big 12 career list, No. 25 Oklahoma State swamps Little Rock 103-61
articles.description: — Audi Crooks reached double figures for the 106th straight game, scoring 20 points to move into ninth on the Big 12 Conference all-time scoring list in No. 25 Oklahoma State's 103-61 win over Little Rock on Friday night.
